summary: Authored the A2 level blueprint (docs/curriculum/blueprints/a2.json + a2.md) against curriculum-master-a1-c2.md and level-blueprint-template.md, reconciled against A1's full design (a1-blueprint.json/a1-map.md), not only its built arcs. 19 capabilities (15 required, 4 should) across 7 arcs and 23 planned episodes (39-61), covering past narration, near-future plans, description/comparison with reason clauses, multi-step directions, room/table booking with dates and spelling, everyday problems, and invitations. All 12 of A1's deferredToA2 items are explicitly resolved except the one permanent exclusion (real personal contact details), verified by script against a1-blueprint.json#deferredToA2. Cross-level prerequisites reference only A1's required capability ids, never should-have/optional ones. Three shared-core requirements were discovered and raised rather than privately implemented: the 'day' semantic type A1 already proposed, two-clause evaluator judgment for hybrid intents, and a privacy boundary so a spelled booking name can never become persisted fact data.
